articleTitle: The New Type Brushless Generator
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: To generate electricity, various kinds of generators are used – electrical machines for converting mechanical energy of rotation into the electrical power. There are two main ways to create excitation flux: placing an excitation winding on rotor or using permanent magnets. Both options have their drawbacks, which limits their scope in industry. The authors of this article proposed a new innovative generator design that does not have brushes and windings on the rotor, which increases its reliability and duration of periods without maintenance. To eliminate the brush and rings, the excitation winding was placed on the stator, as were the output winding coils. In this case, it is not necessary to supply an excitation current to rotor, which is the commutator of an excitation magnetic flux. By changing the current of the excitation winding, we can adjust value of the generator output voltage, and compensate for its change during fluctuations in the rotation speed or load surge. The design of the generator is simple and can be used in wind turbines, as well as in the power grids of autonomous objects. Also, this design is convenient for use of superconductivity.

articleTitle: Railway Point Machine Control Automation Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: In this article, the method of remote control of signals in stations with local control, which is used in railway stations, is considered. The analysis of control schemes of 2-, 3-, 4-, 9-wire direct current and 3-, 5-, 7-wire alternating current railway point machine, which are currently used in the electric centralization systems available in the Joint Stock Company “Uzbekistan Railways”, is presented. The article also presents the algorithm of the method of controlling the railway point machine using wireless communication with the help of constant and variable current microprocessor control modules. The method of controlling and controlling the railway point machine using wireless communication can provide the following advantages compared to the method of controlling and controlling the railway point machine using a wired connection: it reduces the operational costs for the equipment of the railway point machine; reduces human factors in local management of railway point machine; reduces maneuvering time; reduces the operating costs of stopping and moving the rolling stock. The safety of the method of controlling and controlling the railway point machine using wireless communication is mathematically based on Markov semi-chains.

articleTitle: Parameters Estimation Technique of the Induction Motor Electric Drive With the Field-Oriented Control Tacking Into Account Core Losses
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The equivalent circuit, as well as the induction motor electromagnetic processes equations, taking into account the core losses, is given. The rotor flux linkage observer structure based on the rotor circuit equations is proposed. The technique for the induction motor equivalent rotor time constant and the equivalent mutual inductance estimation are described, which is necessary for correct estimation of the rotor flux vector amplitude and the rotation angle. The method for parameter estimation is based on their step-by-step selection and verification of the estimation correctness fulfillment condition. For the proposed parameter estimating method, the necessary tools are listed. The results of parameter estimation for a traction asynchronous motor are presented.

articleTitle: Development of a Methodology to Assess the Impact Degree of High-Power Drives with Active Rectifiers on the Electricity Quality in In-plant Power Supply Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Active rectifiers are widely used on industrial sites today. These units are part of high power regulated alternating current drives. Their use is due to a number of advantages over classic diode rectifiers, such as the ability to recover braking energy into the supply network and, according to the manufacturers, better electromagnetic compatibility. However, experience in operating these devices shows that due to the use of pulse-width modulation in active rectifiers, there is a high severe distortion probability of supply mains voltage by high order harmonics, with numbers higher than 40-50. The essence of this phenomenon is the occurrence of a voltage drop in the high impedance parts of the network frequency response when even a small high-frequency current is flowing. The presence of high impedance sections in the frequency response is due to the parallel resonance between the inductance of the network transformer and the equivalent capacitance of the cables from the substation. Modern power quality standards applied in different countries do not take into account harmonics above 40-50 which makes it very difficult to assess the impact of high-power drives with active rectifiers on power quality in the supply network by conventional, certified power quality analysers. Therefore, it is an urgent task to develop a specialised methodology to assess the impact degree of a particular active rectifier on the network.

articleTitle: Identify the Position of the Shaft and Hole Using a Force-Torque Sensor in Three-Point Contact Assembly Operations
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Nowadays, the methods of robotic assembly of cylindrical joints are popular. However, before assembling, pegs and sleeves need to be adjusted. In practice, if there is a significant misalignment of the position of the shaft and sleeve, seizure or deformation may occur during the assembly process. This article proposes a method for determining the shaft position and sleeve using a force-torque sensor. Creating a three-point contact position is estimated using the force-torque sensor. Experimental setup based on an ABB IRB-140 industrial robot with an IRC5 controller, coupling parts with a gap 0.04 mm the effectiveness of the proposed method is confirmed. Building the structure of the system of an adaptive algorithm for controlling a robot with a force-moment sensor, which recognizes contact situations, will allow reliable assembly of precision joints and prevent jamming of parts during the process of pairing. In this work, equations are obtained that connect the parameters of the position and orientation of the connected part with the information issued by the force and moment sensor of the assembly robot with three-point contact.

articleTitle: Experimental Studies of Power Quality in the 34.5 kV Network of MMK Metalurji During Operation of Electric Drives with Active Rectifiers
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Medium voltage distribution networks of 6 - 35 kV are used in in-plant power supply systems in steel mills. As a mutual influence result of the capacitances of long cable lines and the inductances of step-down transformers, resonance phenomena can occur in the medium frequency range. If the high-frequency harmonics generated by frequency converters with active rectifiers fall into the resonant range, this can lead to disturbances in the plant’s internal distribution network. Such phenomena can cause long downtime of technological equipment and product defects. This entails significant economic losses, especially in the production of high value-added products. This paper reflects the experimental research results of voltage quality in 34.5 kV distribution networks of metallurgical plant “MMK Metalurji”. Measures for electromagnetic compatibility improvement of frequency converters with active rectifiers of electric drives in hot strip mill 1750 with supply mains are proposed.

articleTitle: The Development of Cutting Tools Active Control Methodology for Numerical Control Milling Machines
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper deals with the issues of the cutting tools (CT) widespread control methodology using tool setters; the new CT active control method is also proposed. The manual operations are reduced by this methodology due to the automatic development of tool setters’ programs via the CT database. The operation adaptation of computer numerical control (CNC) machines is provided by upgrading tool setters’ functioning algorithms. Both the CNC machines production performance increasing and the required product workmanship achievement of machine-building as well as instrument-making production might be received through the new methodology application. The advantages of this methodology are, firstly, cost-effectiveness due to the use of standard CNC machines sensors and, secondly, exclusion of manual processing for measurement results.

articleTitle: Risk Assessment for Digitalization of Facilities of Cyber-Physical Energy System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: In the context of the energy transition to intelligent distributed energy, there is an ongoing digital transformation of the properties of energy systems based on the application of information and intelligent technologies to management and digitalization of facilities. In this regard, there has been noted an increase in the number of vulnerabilities of information-and-communications and technological infrastructures of cyber-physical energy systems (CPES) to new threats, including those caused by cyberattacks. For the normal operation of the CPES, it becomes important to minimize the consequences when risks arise under digital transformation and informatization of power system facilities. This report analyzes the possible factors contributing to the emergence of risks in the process of digitalization in the energy industry, identifies cybersecurity threats most dangerous in terms of their consequences, and assesses the risks through a case study of a real-world power system.

articleTitle: Computer Modeling of the Processes Arising During Arcing Ground Faults in 35 kV Resistance Grounded Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This article represents the results of metallic and arcing phase-to-earth faults in 35 kV overhead distribution networks with high or low neutral grounding resistance. The cylindrical symmetrical channel model of an vertically oriented arc, stabilized by rising convective gas flow, was carried out by ATPDraw software. The oscillograms of phase-to-earth fault currents and striking voltages were obtained with the help of the created computer arc model, as well as oscillograms of temperature evolution in the central channel, resistance, and arc radius. Based on the obtained results, the analysis of neutral grounding resistance efficiency during ground faults was determined. It shows that taking into account the arc equations leads to rapid arc self-quenching. Moreover, the mathematical model of the arc indicates that an increase in the active fault current component to a certain value helped to change a transient arcing combustion mode into a steady one. The obtained results should be used to justify the real number of phase-to-earth faults with arc self-quenching (including during restrikes). And for steady arcing phase-to-earth faults resisting neutral grounding should be used to quickly locate the fault.

articleTitle: An Automated Software Package Creation for Energy Consumption Accounting
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Modern world market relations put forward rigorous requirements for conditions of information exchange and implementation of automated systems for commercial accounting and sale of thermal and electric energy. Data collection of the amount of energy consumed is often carried out through manual entry of information, that does not exclude probable errors. Besides, errors may occur when data are integrated into internal and external information systems. A software package for household energy consumption metering was worked out. Its architecture is built on a centralized principle; interaction with users is carried out through a web interface. The developed metering software package provides control over the performance, operation mode of main networks and central heating units. It consists of 12 functional blocks; the paper covers the purpose of each of them. The automated software package is designed to obtain thermal energy consumption data, their following processing by means of automatic analysis and automated transfer to the customer billing system.

articleTitle: Automation of Combined Irrigation System Control in Greenhouses with Electrochemically Activated Water
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: rrigation is one of the main technological processes in greenhouse farming, which provides qualitative and volumetric indicators of produced products. The combined irrigation technology which combines low-volume drip and aerosol irrigation methods of is widespread. The proposed combined irrigation system includes a unit (device) for electrochemical activation (ECA) of water. Extended abilities of this system are caused by the reactivity of catholyte and anolyte, which are metastable products of water ECA. The use of the ECA unit for water as a part of combined irrigation system expands technological modes of irrigation. Drip and aerosol irrigation is supplemented by three modes: drip irrigation with catholyte, aerosol irrigation with catholyte, aerosol irrigation with anolyte. The control of the irrigation technological parameters (soil moisture, air humidity, soil pH) is carried out by retrieving the relevant sensors data and comparing the obtained values with the set ones. When the set points are reached, the relevant technological links (electric pumps and electromagnetic valves) are switched off by the microcontroller signal. Automation of the combined irrigation system, in addition to resource-saving, is also targeted to prevent technological modes violations due to the subjective (“human”) factor.

articleTitle: Using Computer Vision to Recognize Defects on the Surface of Hot-rolled Steel
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The problem of recognizing defects on the surface of hot-rolled steel is quite old, but technology has only recently reached a sufficient level to enable automation of this process. One of the most suitable methods is applying convolutional neural networks (CNN). We selected the Northeastern University surface defect database, which is a dataset of the most identified cases of hot rolled defects, as the qualitative dataset for network training. This article presents CNN models to recognize 6 defects with an accuracy of 93.59% and 6 defects and images of a clean surface with an accuracy of 92.31%. The recognition time was 0.001384±5% seconds for all samples. As well, program give recommendations based on the most common defects of a particular type.

articleTitle: Voltage Measuring Sensor Based on Capacitive Voltage Divider
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The use of new innovative devices in modern conditions makes it possible to obtain information about the state of the power line in real time, which in turn increases the reliability of power transmission. This article describes an autonomous voltage sensor with wireless information transmission and tests carried out in the laboratory and on the operating 10 kV line. The voltage sensor is made in the form of a capacitive voltage divider, the first lining of which is a current conductor, the second is an insulated metal rod parallel to the current conductor, suspended from the first lining at a distance of the thickness of the rod insulation. The power supply unit of the sensor consists of two current transformers and reserve capacitors, which ensures stable operation of the device over a long period. The measured data on the potential difference between the conductor and the rod is sent via a wireless radio channel. The assembly is flashed with firmware that implements all the basic operations in the network of the IEEE 802.15.4 standard. It allows you to form new networks, join an existing network, organize data relaying and automatic network recovery.

articleTitle: Implementation of the RISC-V Architecture with the Extended Zbb Instruction Set
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: RISC-V is a new and rapidly developing instruction set architecture, the main feature of which is its openness for the free use. For this reason, RISC-V is becoming more and more popular among companies with a wide range of specializations, both with hardware and software developers. The RISC-V architecture specification defines a set of standard extensions in addition to the basic instruction set architecture that can be useful in a variety of applications among which is the use in automation and process control systems in Electrical power engineering. One of the useful extensions is an extension for bit manipulation, whose instructions were originally invented by Intel and ARM in order to improve power consumption and performance. This work presents an implementation of the Zbb extension of basic bit manipulation in the Verilog language. The developed module is integrated into the schoolRISCV soft processor core. Its modeling and verification of correct operation were carried out using the ModelSim software. The processor was synthesized and prototyped on the Terasic DEI-SoC FPGA board. In addition, support for new instructions from the implemented extension was added to the assembler. Runtime simulator RARS was used also. The analysis of the performance of the extended core showed an average acceleration of the program execution by 29.9%; the amount of memory occupied was reduced by 37.5%. The increase in performance was achieved due to the consumption of a larger number of logic elements and registers.

articleTitle: Interconnect Routing on Two Signal Layers of a Modal Reservation PCB: a Case Study
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper presents a quasistatic simulation of the method of tracing interconnects on two signal layers of a printed circuit board (PCB) with modal reservation (MR) performed in the TALGAT and ADS systems jointly used to determine the application scope of the method in the design of modern electronic equipment. The protective characteristics are analyzed without taking into account losses in the TALGAT system. It is shown that when the ratio of the lengths of the structures located on the outer and inner layers is equal to 0.9, the probability of all types of failures (described by N-norms) over the entire structure length is smaller than for ratios of 0.1 and 0.3. Signal integrity was analyzed in the ADS system, taking into account losses in conductors and dielectrics. For the structure under study, the lowest cutoff frequency was 440 MHz. With an increase in the length ratio between structures with conductors on the outer and inner layers, the signal integrity deteriorates greatly. The simulation results obtained both in TALGAT and ADS are compared, with losses in conductors and dielectrics taken into account. Voltage ware forms are presented for three cases (0.1, 0.3, and 0.9) of the length ratio for the structures located on the outer and inner layers. The maximum amplitude difference is 3%. Thus, the data obtained in TALGAT and ADS for specific tasks can be used jointly in analyzing the method of tracing interconnections on two signal layers of the PCB with MR.

articleTitle: Research of Attenuation of the Electromagnetic Wave Amplitude by Organic Materials in a Coaxial Cell
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Measurements of S-parameters in a coaxial chamber of organic materials and impurities with different chemical compositions were performed. The results of the estimation of attenuation of the electromagnetic wave (EMW) amplitude by organic materials depending on their chemical composition are presented. It is shown that different liquids affect the attenuation of the EMW amplitude of some mixtures more strongly than others. The EMW attenuation is calculated depending on the content of organic materials in a mixture of coal and starch. The effect of temperature on EMW attenuation in a wide frequency range using a coaxial camera is estimated. It is revealed that the electrophysical properties change depending on the temperature. The proposed method demonstrated that a coaxial cell can be used to analyze the attenuation of the EMW amplitude in mixtures based on organic materials. This can be useful for analyzing the electrophysical properties of mixtures including organic components, including under different temperature conditions.

articleTitle: Provision of the Required Performance of Technological Processes on the Basis of Automation of Flows Redistribution
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article considers the problem of optimizing technological processes based on improving the distribution of material flows. This task is formulated on the basis of a systematic approach, which consists in the fact that a multidimensional indicator is chosen as a system indicator. The indicator takes into account not only the connections between elements, but also the degree of use of these connections during the functioning of a system or network. This allows to distribute material flows by changing the elements of the routing matrix in the model of an open queuing network in order to optimize the system. The algorithm procedures allow to automate the transfer of part of the load of elements that are bottlenecks to other elements of the system. The efficiency and practical significance of the scientific and methodological apparatus proposed in the work is confirmed by a methodological example.

articleTitle: Quasi-Static Simulation of a Double-Sided PCB with Triple Modal Reservation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article continues the study of modal reservation (MR) - a new method of cold redundancy of circuits that simultaneously improves electromagnetic compatibility. The results of quasi-static simulation of a double-sided printed circuit board with a triple MR are presented. First, a lossless analysis was carried out, after which the per-init-length electrical parameters of the structure and the bend were obtained with two sets of parameters. Then, linear combinations of modes are determined that give the greatest distortions in the time-domain characteristic. Then, a lossy time-domain analysis was performed, after which the N-norms were measured. The protective characteristics were analyzed and showed that the maximum amplitude of decomposition pulses at the far end of the structure increased by a maximum of 27%. The signal integrity analysis was performed, for which the cutoff frequency was determined from the frequency response, and the parameters of the excitation pulse were obtained from it. It is shown that it is not distorted in the structure before and after failures.

articleTitle: Modernization of Industrial Shunting Diesel Locomotives for Technological Railway Transport
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper highlights the results of the development and implementation of traction electrical equipment sets based on asynchronous motor-generators and traction electric motors for electromechanical transmissions of industrial shunting diesel locomotives for technological railway transport at the stage of deep modernization of the TGM-6 diesel locomotives series. In the process of modernization, the old internal combustion engine and hydromechanical transmission were replaced by TESS. The achieved indicators for improving the traction and dynamic characteristics and reliability of the locomotive, fuel economy and operating costs in comparison with serial shunting diesel locomotives with an electromechanical transmission based on synchronous generators and DC electric motors, as well as shunting diesel locomotives with hydraulic transmission are shown.

articleTitle: Investigation of LC Filter Function Based on Multifunctional Integrated Electromagnetic Component
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The purpose of the study is to increase reliability, reduce the weight and dimensions of electrical noise filtering systems. This goal is achieved by applying methods of functional integration of electromagnetic components. The problem of developing an electrical noise filtering system based on a multifunctional integrated electromagnetic component has been posed and solved. The authors have developed a computer model of an LC filter based on a multifunctional integrated electromagnetic component in the MatLab software package. Graphs of the output voltage are obtained. Schemes of LC filters are analyzed. The authors assembled a laboratory bench, which includes an LC filter circuit based on a multifunctional integrated electromagnetic component. Output voltage waveforms were taken. The analysis of a computer model and a laboratory stand was carried out. The possibility of using a multifunctional integrated electromagnetic component as an LC filter with improved weight and size parameters and increased reliability has been proven.

articleTitle: Development of a Methodology for Selecting Optimum Asymmetric Arc Combustion Modes in Ladle-Furnace Installations under Different Argon Purging Regimes
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper develops a methodology for selecting optimum asymmetric arc combustion modes in ladle-furnace plants at different argon purging modes. The previously developed algorithm for adapting the electric mode of ladle-furnaces (LF) to the argon blast intensity using the slag factor is briefly discussed. It is noted that for this algorithm to operate it is necessary to form a set of operating curves that would provide for timely shortening of electric arc lengths depending on the influence degree of the liquid metal mirror on specific phases. It is significant that the issue of selecting the optimal values of the operating parameter settings for a given set of operating curves is not covered in sufficient detail in modern scientific and technical literature. In this connection, main configuration variants of single and double-position LFs according to the location of blow-off plugs and emergency tuyeres have been considered. For each variant criteria that allow carrying out iterative search for optimal values of control parameter settings have been generated. Experience in practical application of new optimization criteria at existing LFs operating on the territory of metallurgical enterprises of the Russian Federation is described. Conclusions are made about the technical effect achieved by the results of the work with reference to actual production figures.

articleTitle: Structure Optimization of the Software and Hardware Complex for Electricity Metering
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The study represents the search for a path optimization of the software and hardware electricity metering complex structure. It is proposed to increase the level of electronic current and voltage transformers merging unit intellectualization. The direction of research is related to the application of the communication standards for digital current and voltage transformers. The study was proposed to pay attention to the quality flags of the received current and voltage values. If the flags already contain emergency information, merging unit can send a quick message. Thus, there will be information about the accident in the data bus of the software and hardware electricity-metering complex much earlier. This optimizes the operation of the electricity metering system due to a faster response to an emergency. The test results are given.

articleTitle: Application of Wavelet Analysis for Synchronization of Current Signals in the Diagnosis of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Diagnostics of permanent magnet synchronous motors (PMSM) is one of the key factors in ensuring the smooth operation of electric drives for various purposes. Various malfunctions of synchronous drives, such as a violation of the original geometric shape, a decrease in the coercive force of the magnets, various destruction of the magnets, such as cracks and chips, can be detected by analyzing the linear current, namely the spectral characteristic. Methods for identifying "mark" on the spectral characteristics and their comparison are referred to as signature analysis. Due to the need to detect the slightest deviations from the original signature, an accurate comparison of the original signal with its standard is necessary. This approach is implemented only under the condition of unambiguous coincidence of the studied signals in terms of their periods and groups of magnets as signal sources. Wavelet transform can be applied as a method of synchronization of two signals.

articleTitle: Active Filters in the Power Supply of Electrified Railway Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: In recent years, there has been an increase in non-linear electrical loads in power supply networks. This is due to the increase in the proportion of alternative energy sources, microprocessor equipment, and semiconductor devices. This inevitably leads to a deterioration in the quality of electrical energy. As a result, the service life of electrical equipment is reduced, and there are cases of unreasonable operation of relay protection devices. This article explores the use of an active filter to improve the quality of the power supply in electrified rail applications. Basic research methods are analytical review, mathematical analysis, modeling, and simulation of power supply systems with an active filter. The use of an active filter reduces the THD from 21.31% to 1.7% with a sample time of 0.5 µs. As a result of the research, the advantages and disadvantages of this method were identified to improve the quality of electrical energy, and alternative methods were proposed.

articleTitle: Quantitative Assessment of Reliability Indicators of Electrical Circuits of 10 Kv Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: One of the most important tasks of the electric power industry is to ensure uninterrupted power supply and reliable operation of all its elements, timely elimination of technological failures, development and implementation of measures for their prevention and elimination. When managing power grid assets, it is necessary to simultaneously process and analyze a lot of different data. Besides, when considering tasks on distribution networks development and ensuring their reliability, it is necessary to take into account economic and ecological aspects. Thus, modern techniques and tools are needed to help manage electrical grids. One of the most important tools in planning is distribution network reliability analysis methods, which can also be applied to assess management effectiveness. This article examines the selection of the optimal scheme of power supply of electrical networks using the method of structural analysis of reliability, on the example of the method of "block diagrams", which represents the object in the form of a set of a certain way connected (in terms of reliability) elements As an example of selection of the optimal scheme of power supply considered distribution network scheme on the example of two looped feeders, each powered from different sections of voltage 10 kV. As a result, it is clearly shown that when changing the scheme of electric network - installation of ringing and sectioning reclosers, there is a significant increase in the reliability of the electric network.

articleTitle: Estimating How the Start-Up of High-Voltage Ground Electric Drive of Oil Transfer Pump Impacts the Oil Well Electric Motor Operation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article presents a Matlab Simulink computational model for an electrical complex of a production well with a chain drive and an oil transfer pump with an asynchronous drive. The model is used to study the effect that starting of an oil transfer pump drive has on the downhole pump electric drive. The simulation was carried out with and without account for the reactive power compensation in the electrical complexes considered. The two simulation options mode parameters are specified and compared. The comparison confirms the increased stability of the electrical complex operation with capacitor units in use when in supply voltage decreases at pumping units electric drives terminals.

Author Keywords: electrical complex of an oil producing unit

articleTitle: Developing and Testing a Control Strategy on Electromechanical Test Bench for Operating a Group of Sucker Rod Pumps for Smoothing the Power Demand Requirement
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article concerns on developing a control strategy for smoothing the power demand of a group of sucker rod pumping unit (SRPU) and test bench for emulating its static and dynamic processes. The nature of the load driven by this type of drives is highly variable and periodic. An electromechanical test bench is developed to emulate the sucker rod pump dynamics and using this platform various tests can be carried out. Moreover, this platform can be used to conduct studies related to smoothing the power demand of a group of SRPU. In this paper, a control strategy is developed in LABVIEW for controlling the pumping speed and phase of a drive, such that a group of SRPUs demand a smoother power as seen from the upstream of the coupling point. To test the control strategy, torque curve, speed curve, and power curve for a reference drive are generated. The controller adjusts the pumping speed and phase of the emulated SRPU relative to the reference drive. The experimental results confirm that the test bench can serve for testing various control systems.

articleTitle: Investigation of Ferroresonance Processes Leading to Thermal Damage of Cast-Insulated Transformers
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: In this paper, a study was made of ferroresonance phenomena in distribution networks with cast resin transformers, which can exist for a long time and lead to thermal damage to transformers. A description of transformer modeling technique based on the construction of its magnetic system substitution scheme, which allows to correctly account for its nonlinear characteristics in such processes, is given. Calculations of electromagnetic transients in EMTP and thermal processes in a transformer were carried out using COMSOL Multiphysics, where transformer design data was used to create models. Based on the results of the calculations, conclusions were drawn about the possible causes of damage to cast resin transformers.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Current Conversion Error of Rogowski Coil in a Wide Temperature Range
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Rogowski coils are widely used for converting high-ampere currents in electrical installations. Large number of manufacturers produce Rogowski coils in various form factors. The use of this type of converters is promising for relay protection of electric power systems equipment due to such advantages as linearity of conversion, absence of saturation and residual magnetization phenomena, high accuracy of high-ampere current conversion. The metrological characteristics of the Rogowski coil depend on various factors that do not affect traditional current converters (electromagnetic transformers). One of these factors is the ambient temperature. The impact of ambient temperature can lead to an irreversible change in the size of coil turn and a corresponding change in the measurement error. In addition, commercially available Rogowski coils have a temperature coefficient of error of the conversion ratio from 0.005 to 0.02%/°C according to datasheets. Non-traditional current converters do not have sufficient experience in the conditions of electric power facilities operating in comparison with electromagnetic transformers. A comprehensive study of the characteristics of Rogowski coils is needed before their large-scale application for current measurement in electric power systems. This article is devoted to the study of the conversion errors of Rogowski coils in a wide temperature range corresponding to a moderately cold climate.

articleTitle: Study of the Values of Active Power Imbalances in Power Systems Caused by Transient Operation of Solar and Wind Power Plants in the UPS of Russia
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article provides information on the dynamics of commissioning of the number and installed capacity of solar and wind power plants operating in the United power system of Russia. The concentration of power plants based on renewable energy sources by regions and by interregional power systems is shown. The data on the normative imbalances of active power in the interregional power systems on the basis of the maximum install capacity of the single power generation units and in comparison with the install capacity of solar and wind power plants is given. It is shown that the commissioning of renewable energy sources and their unstable operation, which depends on weather conditions, makes it necessary to commission additional reserves of active power at hydro and thermal power plants. In general, the impact of renewable energy sources on the functioning of the power system is reduced to a decrease in the efficiency of the technical and economic functioning of the entire power system and to an accelerated increase in electricity tariffs.

articleTitle: Dual Droop-Based Controllers for Hybrid Microgrid with Photovoltaic and Wind Turbine Distributed Generators
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: For a successful operation of a hybrid type Microgrid, power-sharing between AC and DC resources is required to be managed and controlled. Power-sharing functionality is realized through power electronic converters governing the power transition between distributed renewable generators and the grid. In this research, dual droop-based controllers are developed for voltage and frequency regulation of hybrid Microgrid. The Microgrid is equipped with photovoltaic solar panels, a wind turbine generator unit, and a battery system to support its operation, especially when disconnected from the utility grid. Various simulation scenarios are orchestrated by changing the operating conditions and the type of the connected load. The results demonstrated a promising future for such grid structures, particularly for industrial applications.

articleTitle: Microprocessor Control of the Sonar Electric Drive
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: the paper presents the design system of the microprocessor electric drive with a switched reluctance motor for the unmanned underwater vehicle (UUV) sonar. To increase the performance of the gearless sonar drive for UUV, the electric drive circuit was proposed, which included the DMB 120 switched reluctance motor, a microprocessor control unit, a transistor converter, position sensor drivers VT 60 and 2BVT2.5. To improve and stabilize the dynamic characteristics of the electric drive system, it is proposed to introduce in the speed control circuit additional two derivatives of the input control signals, controllable by a function of the relative speed error and its derivative, and to introduce a self-tuning control circuit with a reference model and signal self-tuning. To improve and stabilize the dynamic characteristics of the electric drive system, it was proposed to introduce in the position control circuit the first and second derivatives of the input position signal, which are controlled as a function of the relative position error. Both derivatives are introduced when the actual trajectory lags behind the position-specified one. A model sample of the gearless electric drive of the UUV sonar was manufactured and tested, which confirmed the theoretical calculations.

articleTitle: The Development of a Vibration Machine with Adjustable Inertial Vibrator
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: In the technological processes of the agro-industrial complex, electric vibration drives are widely used for a range of vibration machines. The most common type of vibration machines are those with a horizontal unbalance rotation axis. The study analyses existing solutions along with a description of their mathematical models used in the design of vibration machines with an adjustable inertial vibrator. This will allow for resonance-free characteristics to be obtained and the amplitude of oscillations to be adjusted. The proposed design of the vibration machine resolves the problem of changing environmental parameters, (humidity, temperature), as well as changes to the processed product. This is achieved by changing the amplitude of the vibration frequency according to any law without stopping the machine or the technological process, excluding any machine down time due to manual intervention. A vibration machine developed in this way allows for the high-quality sorting, cleaning and pre-sowing preparation of potatoes and grain mixtures in accordance with agrotechnological requirements.

articleTitle: Improving the Power Supply Reliability for Industrial Consumers Through High-Speed Bus Transfer
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Improving the reliability of power supply to industrial consumers is a key requirement for power supply quality assurance. Using a high-speed bus transfer (HBT) device is one of the most efficient methods to achieve this. These devices are designed to improve the reliability of power supply to the key consumers and assure the transient stability of a complex electric motor load during short-term power supply outings. The HBT operation is based on the continuous monitoring of phase voltage and current values on the buses of the two input terminals of the switchgear, their transformation into complex active positive sequence voltage and current values with the subsequent software treatment of the measurement results. This work reviews the key operating principles for the device and analyzes the key advantages of its application at industrial companies. The article presents the results of the HBT operation within the power grid of a metal production facility during an emergency at one of the substations with key consumers. The authors study the HBT triggering after the loss of power on one of the substation bus sections. Based on the research results, some conclusions are made concerning the efficiency of transient stability assurance for a complex electric motor load during short-term power supply outings.

articleTitle: Advantages of Transforming the Relay Protection Operating Characteristics into Characteristics in Multidimensional Space
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: In the classical theory of relay protection, the recognition of emergency modes is carried out based on operating characteristics. Proper selection of the operating characteristics ensures the selectivity of relay protection. Traditionally, the operating characteristics of relay protection devices are defined on a plane. However, this approach does not always provide unambiguous recognition of emergency modes. The classical approach to the formation of the operating characteristics sometimes leads to the display in the same area of the operating characteristics of various electrical system modes, turning the recognition of emergency modes into an unsolvable task. The report describes one of the approaches to the analysis of the operating characteristics of relay protection. In the example of the phase selection and fault classification, it is shown that the classical approach to the formation of the operating characteristics has limitations and introduces uncertainties in the tasks of mode recognition. This complicates the implementation of relay protection functions, requiring the implementation of additional blocking and backing. To overcome this imperfection, the report’s authors propose a new strategy for improving the operating characteristics of relay protection. It is demonstrated that the transformation of classical operating characteristics into characteristics in multidimensional space through the possible expansion of the information base and the presentation of operating characteristics provides recognition of various short-circuit modes in the electrical network.

articleTitle: The Experience of using Specialised Correction Filters to Improve Power Quality in Electrical Networks with Active Rectifiers
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This paper presents the science-based technical solutions and measures to improve energy performance of the electrical complexes that include high-power frequency converters with active rectifiers (FC with AR) through the use of specialized passive filters (SPF). Processing of the experimental data was carried out in a mathematical package Matlab with the application Simulink, where analysis of voltage quality of 10 kV network, with and without SPF was conducted using the data obtained at the existing metallurgical complexes of JSC “Severstal” (Russia), JSC “Balakovo Steel Factory” (Russia), “MMK Metalurji” (Turkey). The article gives the application efficiency study results of specialized passive filters in the internal power supply systems of the rolling complexes, functioning at PJSC “Severstal”, JSC “Balakovo Steel Factory”, “MMK Metalurji”. Key research insights presented in the work have novelty, theoretical and practical significance. One of the main results is the SPF use recommendation for the negative influence exclusion of the resonance phenomena. The findings of the study can be used in the design of power supply systems at the metallurgical enterprises, having in their composition powerful electric drives with active rectifiers, to ensure electromagnetic compatibility and improve the electricity quality.

articleTitle: Investigation of System Properties and Connections of Electrical Engineering Systems for Assessment of Selectivity of Power Line Differential Protection with a Series Compensation Device
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The work investigates the system properties and connections of electrical engineering systems to evaluate the selectivity of the differential protection of a power line with a series compensation device. The study was carried out using the methods of computer simulation of transient and steady modes in a short circuit and functional programming. Main parameters that affect the nature of electromagnetic transients and the steady state during a short circuit on a power line with a series compensation device are the degree of compensation of the series compensation device, the time of occurrence of damage, the flow of active power caused by the difference in voltage angles at the ends of the line. It is shown that the series compensation devices affect the selectivity of the line differential protection only in the steady-state short circuit mode, since at the first moment of damage there is a transient process related to recharging of the capacitors used in a series compensation device; regardless of the degree of series compensation, this causes a surge of current from the series compensation device to the fault location. In this case, a special case of failure of the differential protection of the line is possible, when the transient process described above is absent or when its value is insignificant. This is caused by a certain value of the haulage angle causing a power flow from the series compensation device to the fault location.

articleTitle: Reducing Electromagnetic Influences of 25 Kv Traction Networks on Extended Metal Structures
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: When the pipeline approaches the ER track, electrified with alternating current, voltages may appear on the pipeline parts caused by the influence of traction networks (TN) of 25 kV. One of the effective measures to reduce the electromagnetic effects of traction networks is based on the use of vehicles equipped with screening and reinforcing wires (SRW). A number of works are devoted to the study of such networks, however, the problems of determining the effectiveness of their use in reducing induced voltages on pipelines are not considered in the works known to the authors. To solve these problems, methods can be used, developed at the Irkutsk State Transport University, together with the Fazonord software product. The article presents the results of studies aimed at determining the effectiveness of the use of the SRW to reduce the induced voltages on the pipeline. The simulation was carried out in relation to the scheme of traction and external power supply of the mountain-pass section of the main railway with a 25 kV traction network. The results obtained showed that the use of the traditional design of the SRW allows to reduce the average values of induced voltages at individual points of the pipe by 22 to 29%, with the maxima at 25 to 33%; the use of split screening and reinforcing wires makes it possible to obtain a decrease in average values by 35 to 45%, with the maxima at 39 to 48%.

articleTitle: Study of the Influence of the Rated Voltage of the On-Board Network of a Modern Car
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: An analysis of trends in the development of modern car designs shows that in recent decades, the most significant growth has been observed in the element base of the on-board electrical and electronic complex (BEC). The problem of oversaturation of the on-board network of cars of traditional designs with electrical and electronic components and the inability of the power supply system to fully provide electrical energy to all consumers is becoming increasingly relevant. There is a tendency for the need to increase the level of the nominal voltage of the on-board network and, accordingly, an additional scientific and technical study of the possibility of organizing the on-board network of modern cars of traditional designs for one supply voltage. The issues of improving the technical and economic indicators of the BEC are solved by choosing the optimal voltage values for each consumer group and for the system as a whole. The main systems that ensure the uninterrupted start of the engine and the operation of all systems and components of the BEC include the systems of: ignition, electric start and power supply. The paper presents the results of a study of the effect of changing the level of the nominal voltage of the on-board network from 12 to 48 V on the electrical characteristics of the ignition system (IS) and the electric starting system (ESS) of traditional passenger cars with an internal combustion engine (ICE).

articleTitle: Development of a Neural Network for Controlling the Synthesis Process of the VS-1 Stabilizer and the Octophore-N Using a Virtual Analyzer
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: At the moment, the control system of the synthesis node of the VS-1 stabilizer and the octophore-N in the open joint stock company “Synthesis-Rubber” is built on devices and automation tools that are morally and technically outdated, which do not allow full control of the technological process. The quality of stabilizer synthesis is controlled by sampling, which does not allow continuous monitoring of the results obtained. The introduction of automatic quality control by continuously measuring the concentration of urotropin in alkylphenol at the stages of the process will increase the degree of automation and reduce the risks of obtaining a low-quality product. In the process of studying the problem, the methods of studying the mathematical model of the virtual analyzer and designing its working model in the Simulink Matlab environment were used. As a result of the project, a virtual analyzer was developed that continuously predicts the process quality indicator in the form of a mass fraction of urotropin after synthesis and a neural network for regulating the technological parameters of the synthesis of the VS-1 stabilizer and octophore-N, which allows improving the quality of the technological process, as well as the degree of its automation.

articleTitle: Effect of Speed Asymmetry on Power and Force Parameters of Rolling Mill Electric Drives
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper is devoted to features of operation of rolling mill main drives during asymmetric rolling. The authors reviewed papers, describing effect of speed asymmetry on power and force parameters of drives of continuous hot and cold rolling mills. There is a need for preliminary calculations of maximum acceptable loads to choose an optimum asymmetry factor and ensure a normal operation mode of the drive. Key results of laboratory and industrial experiments on asymmetric rolling on various facilities are described in brief. Special attention is given in this paper to processing and analyzing data obtained during the industrial experiment conducted on continuous five-stand mill 630 with speed asymmetry. The paper presents data on an operation mode of the main drives of such mill during symmetric and asymmetric rolling, as well as some calculated electrical, power and force parameters. The results were compared and showed a significant decrease in forces, total torques and rolling power, and electricity consumption during speed asymmetry. The authors made conclusions and suggested areas of further studies on this field.

articleTitle: Methods of Periodic Complex Remote Measurement of Partial Discharge Characteristics in Highvoltage Insulators
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Diagnostics of the state of high voltage insulators is an important direction in the electric power industry. In the last twenty years, a method for determining the technical condition of high voltage insulation by registering partial discharge (PD) parameters has been actively developed. Despite the active development, in Russia there is only GOST R 55191-2012 (IEC 60270:2010), which considers the measurement of PD by the contact (traditional) method of two main characteristics of individual PDs: the apparent charge (intensity) and the voltage of its occurrence. The problem today is the lack of regulatory documents for the development and calibration of remote non-destructive methods. Based on our own experiments and experiments of other scientists, methods for periodic complex remote measurement of PD characteristics were developed and proposed, including contact electrical and non-contact acoustic, electromagnetic and electro-optical methods.

Author Keywords: methods of measuring the characteristics of partial discharges

articleTitle: The Simulation of Fault Prediction Processes in Distribution Energy Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper discusses the possibilities of modeling the fault prediction processes in distribution energy networks. To carry out modeling based on classification and prediction, the belonging of a component in distribution energy systems to one of the groups as dependent variables is used. The algorithm on the basis of which models for classification and prediction using regression analysis are formed is given. The criterion for the quality of clustering is determined on the basis of a metric. The results of the development of a model for forecasting and classifying the occurrence of malfunctions in the components of distribution energy systems are presented. The illustration of the frequency of coincidence of real data and forecast when applied logistic regression models. The illustration of the standards of the model parameters for the classification and prediction of the occurrence of a malfunction is given.

articleTitle: Impact of Geoinduced Currents on Excitation Mode of Synchronous Generator at Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The authors developed an equivalent circuit for the synchronous generator and a transformer unit. It could help determine the magnetizing current parameters for a generator transformer when the magnetic system is saturated due to geoinduced currents provided the synchronous generator has an automated excitation controller. The authors identified the dependencies of the magnetizing current fundamental harmonic on the magnetizing power of the generator transformer and the geoinduced current value. The article provided numerical values for the fundamental harmonic of the magnetizing current and power at various geoinduced current values for a TDTs 400000/242/20 generator transformer. It is demonstrated that the increase in the reactive power of the synchronous generator results from the operation of the automated excitation controller aimed at maintaining the constant voltage in the generator buses by the excitation current increase. The authors identified the safe value ranges for the excitation order to compensate the increase in the magnetizing power of the generator transformer without any current overloads on the rotor and stator or any reduction in the synchronous generator active load.

articleTitle: Simplified Method for Calculating Mechanical Characteristics of Induction Motor Drive with Scalar Frequency Control
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Calculation of mechanical and electromechanical characteristics of widely spread induction motor drives requires a different set of parameters depending on the problem being solved. The operating, mechanical and energy characteristics of an induction motor drive can be calculated using the electrical equivalent circuit. However the manufacturers of induction motors do not provide information about the parameters of the equivalent circuit in the electric machine parameters passport data. The only parameters well known are the parameters for induction motors of the 4A series. At the same time absolute parameters are necessary for simulation, setting up frequency converters (FC) in vector control systems and making express analyses of scalar frequency control systems operability in a large range of the rotation speed and torque. In this paper, the simplified method for calculating the mechanical characteristics of an induction motor drive with frequency scalar control based on reference data of absolute parameters of induction motors (IM) of the 4A series is considered.

articleTitle: Analysis of Methods for Solving the Problem of Monitoring the Operability of the Electrical Complex of an Autonomous Transport Facility
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article presents materials on the analysis of methods for solving the problem of monitoring the operability of the electrical complex of an autonomous transport facility. Their advantages and disadvantages are determined. The method of a reference voltage divider with symmetry and asymmetry of the divider resistances is considered. The optimal value of the divider resistance is determined, at which the measurement error will be minimal. The results of the error estimation in the reference divider method and the results of simulation modeling of models of the monitoring system of the complex’s operability with symmetry and asymmetry of insulation resistance values are presented. On the basis of simulation modeling, an idealized voltage divider replacement circuit is compiled. The results of the analysis of methods for monitoring the operability of the electrical power supply complex by the criterion of insulation resistance are presented.

articleTitle: Inverter Asynchronous Electric Drive System with PAM and PWM Control
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper considers the structure of a three-phase two-stage frequency converter with voltage control at the input of an inverter for frequency asynchronous electric drive systems. The disadvantages of this structure are shown when using traditional input rectifier circuits, which are designed to operate at a constant level of rectified voltage. Two innovative circuits of the controlled rectifiers are proposed, each of which operates on the principle of the Cuk converter. The innovative rectifiers with adjustable voltage for PAM (pulse amplitude modulation) control are the step-up-step-down, have high electromagnetic compatibility at the input and output and reduce the loss of active power in the rectifier-inverter frequency converter. Waveforms of the input and output voltages and currents, the control and load characteristics of the proposed circuits and the dependence of their input power factors on the degree of regulation of the rectified voltage are given. Waveforms of the output controlled phase voltage and current of the inverter are also shown for various control parameters. Some power losses figures of the proposed frequency converter with circuits of the input innovative rectifier are given.

articleTitle: Influence of Non-Linear Load on Single-Phase Fault Current in Electrical Networks with Isolated Neutral
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper considers the influence of a non-linear load on the single-phase fault current in electrical networks with an isolated neutral. The conducted studies are aimed at assessing the electrical and fire safety of electrical networks operating in such a neutral grounding mode, when a significant number of non-linear consumers appear in them. It has been established that the presence of higher harmonics in the load current can lead to an increase in the effective value of the fault current. A method for calculating currents in the place of insulation damage is proposed, taking into account the non-linearity of the load. The influence of the transient resistance at the site of a single-phase fault on the value of the fault current and on its spectral composition is described. The experimental studies performed on a low-voltage power grid model confirmed the reliability of the calculations. This research was funded by the Federal Agency for Fishery of Russian Federation (contract No. 122030900054-0).

articleTitle: Reducing Transient Resistance in Contact Connections of Electrical Installations in Oil Industry
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: An electrically conductive material with a unique composition was proposed to fill the contact gap to reduce transient resistance and protect a contact connection from oxidation. The actual problem of reducing the contact resistance is solved by a continuous metal coating of the contact surfaces using a plastic conductive material. The technology developed and brought to industrial use makes it possible to significantly reduce contact resistance, protect contact surfaces, and restore previously damaged metal coatings. This technology has found application in electrical installations for processing the contact surfaces of demountable electrical contact connections during the production, installation of new equipment, during scheduled preventive repairs and restoration work, on electrical contact connections of existing electrical equipment in DC and AC circuits. Reducing the resistance of current-carrying elements has a positive effect on energy efficiency indicators. The composition of a plastic electrically conductive material and its properties are investigated. Method of manufacture is described, test results are given.

articleTitle: Rapid-Prototyping of Vibration-Driven Propulsion System for Robots and its Investigation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper presents results of experimental studies of a vibration-driven propulsion system for mobile worm-like robots. The propulsion system is made from standard electromagnetic relays of small ratings. Such the relatively simple design can be used to develop students’ skills in experimental works. Besides, this construction also makes it easy to understand the basics of vibration-driven worm-like robots and the principles of their control. The locomotion of the worm-like robot was implemented on a horizontal surface inside linear guides. The paper describes the simplest open-loop control system. The main parameters that affect the speed of locomotion were studied. It was found that the average speed of directional movement is on the order of 1 mm per second. The magnitude of the applied voltage practically does not influence the average speed. On the other hand, an increase in frequency leads to a near directly proportional increase in the average speed.

articleTitle: The Features of the Alternating-Current Power Transmission Series Capacitance Under Geomagnetic Perturbances
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This article focuses on the possibility of increasing the carrying capacitance of electric power lines by shunt and series compensation under geomagnetic perturbances. The authors provide a numerical example demonstrating that it is possible to obtain an almost identical two fold increase in the carrying capacitance of a power line using either the shunt-series compensation or the series capacitance when there are no geomagnetic perturbances present, yet only the latter method can also block geoinduced currents in the phase conductors of the power line and the high-voltage windings of power transformers. The authors show that, due to the blocking of geoinduced current in the series capacitance unit capacitors, there appears an extra quasi-direct voltage component whose value is proportionate to the intensity of the horizontal component of the geoelectric field and the length of the power line. The voltage swing in the series capacitance unit capacitors was calculated. During geomagnetic perturbances, it increases as a result of summing the quasi-direct component caused by the blocking of geoinduced currents and the alternating voltage component caused by the power transit along the power line. The authors justify the adjustment of the series compensation to prevent the increase in the voltage swing to the limit value.

articleTitle: Active-Adaptive Algorithms for Control Power Grids with RES
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This article presents an algorithm for controlling the operation of a wind farm with a redundant network. The problem of controlling such and similar installations is analyzed, a universal algorithm is compiled in which it is only necessary to change some parameters depending on the wind generator. Various variants of the algorithm implementation are considered, as well as ways to increase the speed and accuracy of the algorithm. Articles in the scientific literature on this topic are being studied. The installations and software of the laboratory complex on which the simulation is performed are described. The technical and technological aspects for the implementation of such systems in different climatic regions and with a different set of generating capacities are given.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Logic Algorithms to Assess the Total Resistance of In-house Power Supply Systems of Factories
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This article analyzes the development of algorithms using the fuzzy logic methods to assess the total resistance of in-house power supply systems of factories for the calculation of electricity losses. Normally, the data on in-house power supply system mode parameters and circuits are quite uncertain. This fact prevents the correct usage of classic deterministic approaches to the study of the operational parameters of equipment in power grids.The article develops the general functioning theory of the low voltage electrical equipment components and describes their systemic properties and connections. The authors provide the mathematical cimulation and optimization of power supply system components in electrical setups using the fuzzy logic algorithms to determine the target function change pattern (total power grid resistance) considering external impacts.

articleTitle: Research of Number and Installed Capacity of the Russian Hydro Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article describes the results of a study of the number and installed capacity structure of hydroelectric power plants in Russia. The structure of the number and installed capacity of hydroelectric power plants was determined for the Unified Power System of Russia and for technologically isolated power systems in regions. The structure of the number and installed capacity is given on the scale of installed capacity by types. The largest hydropower plants name and technological parameters are given. The chronology of the commissioning of the number and installed capacity hydroelectric power plants in the Soviet period from 1925 to 1991, and in the modern Russian period from 1992 to 2020 is indicated.

Author Keywords: hydroelectric power plants quantity and installed capacity concentration and classification

articleTitle: Method and Algorithm for Synthesis of Controlled Digital Low-Pass Butterworth Filters on the Example of A 4th Order Filter
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article presents a method for synthesizing controlled digital recursive low-pass filters with an infinite impulse response and its modification for Butterworth filters. Controllability refers to the explicit dependence of the filter coefficients on the cutoff frequency. The technique is based on a bilinear transformation of the transfer function of an analog low-pass filter prototype and frequency transformation of the amplitude-frequency characteristics of the resulting digital filter. The main idea of the technique is that for an analog prototype filter with a cutoff frequency of 1 rad/s, the parameters of the transfer function of biquadrate or bilinear links having a frequency dimension will be numerically equal to the correction coefficients of similar parameters of a controlled filter with an arbitrary cutofffrequency. As an example, the case of synthesis of a fourth-order Butterworth digital filter is considered. In this case, the transfer function of a filter of arbitrary order is represented as a cascade connection of links of order II, if the filter is of even order (in the case of odd order, one cascaded link of I order is added). The algorithm is implemented in the Mathcad environment. As an example, a digital recursive low-pass Butterworth filter 4<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> order is calculated.

articleTitle: Optimization of a Modal Filter Realized on a Double-Sided Printed Circuit Board
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This paper considers the protection of radioelectronic equipment from the effects of ultra-wideband interference. This paper presents the results of optimizing the cross section parameters of the modal filter (MF) realized on a double-sided printed circuit board. Two configurations of the filter are considered: when the reference conductors are connected only at the ends of the line and when they are connected along the whole length of the filter. For the optimized parameters, the results of attenuation are presented when the boundary conditions at the ends of the passive conductor are changed from the matched to open circuit (OC) or short circuit (SC). It is shown that when the reference conductors are connected only at the ends and the distance between the signal and reference conductors is small, three pulses come to the MF output. When the reference conductors are connected along the entire length, there are two of them. For the MF on a double-sided PCB with reference conductors connected only at the ends, the attenuation reached 3.2 times the half e.m.f., and the difference of the per-unit-length mode delay was 2.35 ns/m. For OC-SC, the attenuation was 5.4 times. The differences of the three per-unit-length mode delays (1.065 ns/m) were maximized and aligned. For the MF with reference conductors connected along the entire length, the difference of per-unit-length mode delays was 2.424 ns/m, and the attenuation was 3 times for the matched case and 5.5 times for OC-SC.

articleTitle: The Energy Potential Assessment for a Road Power Plant with the Slider-Rocker Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: According to Rosavtostat, poor visibility is the main cause of traffic accidents involving pedestrians. It is hard for drivers to notice pedestrians and pedestrian crossings at dusk and after dark even if there is a road sign. Currently, autonomous wind-and-solar plants are used to increase traffic safety. That being said, the global research community is studying the prospects of using road power plants in practice. The operating principle of such plants is converting the motion energy of cars into elec-tricity. The goal of this research is to determine the forces applied to the road power plant mecha-nisms when a car passes through it. The forces occurring in the mechanical components converting the energy of a passing car into electricity were determined during the force study of the road power plant. The calculations showed that a passage of an average car weighing 1600 kg through the road power plant creates a torque effect of 393 Nm on the generator shaft. Simultaneously, a moment of resistance occurs in the generator whose value depends on the speed of the passing car: the moment of resistance equals 115 Nm at 20 kmph, 260 Nm at 30 kmph, 390 Nm at 40 kmph. The amount of energy accumulated by the flywheel is proportional to the speed value, and it takes the following values: 94 J at 20 kmph, 210 J at 30 kmph, and 330 J at 40 kmph. The calculation data show that the road power plant is effective at the set parameters of struc-tural components.

articleTitle: Method for Experimental Study of Circuits with Triple Modal Reservation in Time and Frequency Domains
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper presents a new method for experimental studies of typical prototypes with triple modal reservation. The authors propose to define the investigated devices in the frequency domain and then by using Advanced Design System software to redefine their characteristics in the time domain. The paper contains recommendations for the preparation and conduction of such experimental studies. Using these recommendations, the authors conducted measurements of the complex S-parameters of the circuits with triple modal reservation in the frequency range from 10 MHz to 18 GHz before and after failures. Then, to analyze the response to ultra-wideband interference, a pulse in the trapezoidal waveform with a duration of 150 ps was excited in Advanced Design System to the input of the reserved circuit. The maximum amplitude value at the end of the reserved circuit is obtained for all the faults studied. The authors also present the optimal order of switching the reserving circuits. This paper proposes the methods for analyzing the frequency and time characteristics. It makes possible to analyze the characteristics of circuits with multiple modal reservation and to determine the optimal switching order for reserving circuits. The proposed method requires commonly used equipment and a minimum set of technical tools that can reduce economic expenditures and time costs.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Frequency-Controlled Electric Drive of the Gas Air Cooling Units
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The regulation of air-cooling leads to energy and raw material savings, an increase in service life and an increase in the reliability of the air cooler, and the efficient conduct of the technological process. The most significant item of gas air cooling units operating costs is the electric power consumed by the fan drive. The authors investigated the frequencycontrolled electric drive of the gas air cooling apparatus. The article presents a description of the technological process of gas transportation, a description of the gas air cooling apparatus, methods of regulation, a method for determining the optimal frequency of the power supply network of the electric drive of the gas air cooling apparatus with frequency regulation.
