The authors also constructed a mathematical model of the gas air cooling apparatus based on an asynchronous electric drive in the Matlab/Simulink.

articleTitle: Pressure and Density of the Mixture - Parameters of the System of Monitoring and Control af the Operation Mode Oil Well
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The article discusses the structural diagram of a low-production well operated with the help of an adjustable pump, divided into three sections: bottom - pump intake, tubing, casing - tubing annulus. The dependence of the pressure and density of the mixture on the depth of an oil well is studied as one of the essential components of the oil production process control algorithm, which has its own characteristics for different methods of raising products to the surface. The results of studies of changes in the density of the oily mixture in the tubing and in the annulus, as well as changes in the density of the oil and water mixture at the bottom-pump section indicate the need to measure pressure in the well at several points. In other words, a necessary and sufficient condition for information support is the installation of remote stationary pressure gauges at the inlet and outlets of the deep pump, as well as inside the tubing and the annulus of the oil producing well with the aim of using them in systems for monitoring and controlling the oil production process. A device is proposed for the simultaneous measurement of pressure inside the tubing and annulus with the possibility of its installation at several control points of the oil well bore. The implementation of the proposed device for the operational control of the operating mode of an oil well will lead to its efficient operation and increase oil production.

articleTitle: Development of a System for Regulating the Excitation of Synchronous Generators of Factory Power Plants Connected to a Powerful Energy System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Currently, there is a fairly active expansion of distributed generation objects to increase the reliability of the power supply of industrial enterprises. The work of such generators is often carried out in a parallel with a high -power power system, which determines the low influence of the source on the voltage level on its tires. Due to the increase in energy generating nodes, the requirements for automatic regulation of excitement increase significantly. In such conditions, the automatic regulation of the excitation of industrial synchronous generators impose ambiguous requirements. Firstly, it is necessary to maintain a given voltage on the tires, and secondly, a given level of static and dynamic stability should be provided, which cannot always be feasible. Thus, on the one hand, pathogens of industrial synchronous machines are being improved, and on the other hand, the laws of automatic regulation of excitement become bulky and complex. Due to the aforementioned requirements, high interest these days are of adaptation of excitation regulation systems to industrial generators and operating conditions. In this work, the law of excitation regulation, adapted to the conditions of factory power supply, was developed and shown when working in parallel with a high -power power system. It allows maintaining a standard voltage level when ensuring static and dynamic stability and takes into account the restrictions related to the load diagram and the imperfection of the cooling of excitation systems. In order to verify the effectiveness of the law of regulation of excitation, studies of static stability were carried out on the mathematical model of the synchronous generator developed in the Matlab environment with various voltage subsidence from the power supply system. Recommendations are given on the adaptation of automatic control systems for excitation systems at factory power plants in order to increase stability.

articleTitle: Investigation of Contact Surfaces of Vacuum Circuit Breakers 35-110 kV Using Electron Microscopy
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Because of the processes that lead to wear of the contacts of vacuum circuit breakers, the purpose of article is to study the effect of contact surface wear on the electrical strength of the arc chute and to find the reasons for the distribution of metal vapors over the contact surfaces (fixed-movable) of vacuum circuit breakers. To solve the problem, a scanning electron microscope AURIGA CrossBeam with EMF Inca XMax 80 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> was used. The article considers the processes that lead to wear of the contacts of vacuum circuit breakers, which in turn significantly affect the electrical strength of the entire contact system. In this article, analysis of the distribution of the intensities of the metals reflections Ni, Cu, Cr on the surface of movable and fixed electrodes is carried out. The analysis will show that the surface structure showed that the spread of metal particles in the center is much smaller than at the edges, which can be caused by the influence of a rotating magnetic field acting on streamers of metal particles.

articleTitle: Using the Principles of Cascade-Frequency Regulation During the Operation of the Nutrient Pumps of the Factory Thermal Power Plant for the Common Manifold
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The development of its own generation of electric energy is one of the features of metallurgical production. Thanks to the use of secondary energy resources, including domain and coke gases, electricity, produced at factory power plants, is significantly cheaper than purchased from the energy system. In turn, to reduce the cost of electricity, it is reducing the consumption of electricity with its own needs. The object of the study in this article is the factory thermal power station of a large metallurgical enterprise, in which most consumers of their own needs receive power from the generator voltage. The power plant in question has 8 energy boilers and 9 turbo generators with a total capacity of more than 200 MW; It provides electricity and warmth of the main workshops of the enterprise, as well as one of the districts of the city. Transportation and supply of the main components of technological production, including water, air and fuel, is carried out by unregulated asynchronous electric drives. The most powerful and responsible of them are nutrient pumps. At the station, 13 nutrient pumps were installed for supplying water to the boiler and working on a common manifold. Currently, they receive power directly from the generator voltage tires 3.15 square meters. The article is devoted to the study of the appropriateness of their connection to the network through frequency converters. In this case, pressure stabilization in the general collector and a decrease in electricity consumption in the system of own needs of the power plant of a metallurgical enterprise will be ensured. To date, pressure regulation in the system is carried out by manual throttling by turning on or disconnecting one of the pumps. Actual and practically significant problem is to ensure the main parameters of nutrient pumps by regulating the speed of electric drives, which will significantly increase the energy efficiency of the power plant. The article presents a review of patent information on optimizing the work of pumping plants. According to the results of comprehensive studies conducted on the developed model, the authors proposed cascade-frequency control of adjustable electric drives of nutrient pumps. The introduction of such a decision will reduce electricity consumption of one of the pumps by more than 20%.

articleTitle: Skidding Process Research for a Four-Axle Shunter Electric Locomotive with a Traction Electric Drive "Frequency Converter - Asynchronous Drive"
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: For a four-axle electric locomotive, a mathematical description of the skidding process was performed with using the “Frequency Converter-Asynchronous Drive” (FC-AD) system. The article relevance lies in the possibility of using a computer model in the development and study of the asynchronous motors’ operation for the electric locomotive drive in various operating modes. The article purpose is to study skidding transient processes on a dynamic computer model of a traction asynchronous electric drive using the FC-AD system for a four-axle electric locomotive. The mathematical modeling methods in the Matlab Simulink environment, the main provisions of the electric drive theory, electric machines, the control systems theory are used. The developed electric drive computer model is tuned to the specific parameters of the traction motors, allows you to calculate transients in the FC-AD system, taking into account the gap selection in the coupling and skidding. The article develops differential equations of motion during skidding and mathematical models’ block diagrams that take into account the traction electric drive operation, taking into account various control and skidding systems of a four-axle electric locomotive.

articleTitle: The Rules for Using Modal Transformation in Traveling Wave Fault Locator
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The accuracy and stability of a single-end traveling wave fault locator directly depend on the correct construction of electrical network model in fault regime. In the regime of ground short circuits this task becomes more difficult due to the need to take into account the components of aerial and ground (zero) modes of power line in the electrical network of fault regime model. Its incorrect solution leads to a decrease in the accuracy of determining the arrival time of the used traveling wave, which, in turn, decreases the accuracy in calculating the distance to the fault. In order to correctly construction of electrical network of fault regime model and accurate estimation the used traveling wave arrival times in locators phase-modal transformation is performed. Such a transformation for single-circuit power line can be one of the invariant Clarke, Karrenbauer or Wedepohl transformations. The classical representation of these transformations cannot be directly applied to the electrical values of a double-circuit power line, consisting of six wires and, accordingly, having six independent modes. The purpose of this article is to illustrate the application of the modal transformation matrix for divide the electrical values of a double-circuit power line into independent components.

articleTitle: Development and Research of the Rogowsky Coil Design with Low Sensitivity to Conductor Displacement
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The Russian energy sector underwent significant changes at the end of the 20th and the beginning of the 21st century [1]. The rapid development of engineering and technology in Russia inevitably led to a constant increase in the power system capacity, which in turn led to an increase in the levels of short circuit (SC) currents. Under such conditions, the problems of ensuring static and dynamic stability, the development of automatic emergency control (AEC) systems and the creation of new types of relay protection and automation systems (RPA) have become priority issues for the development of the electric power industry [2]. In particular, recently one of the most important issues is the creation of more advanced current sensors based on non-traditional primary converters [3–7]. A huge breakthrough in solving the tasks was made thanks to the development of computer technology. Electromagnetic and static relays were replaced by microprocessor technologies, the main advantage of which is a high-resistance input, which allows to use previously inaccessible low-power devices. One of these devices is the Rogowski coil, which is one of the types of nontraditional primary current converters. The disadvantage of the split Rogowski coil is the dependence of the metrological characteristics of the transducer on the position of the conductor. This article is devoted to the development of methods for reducing this dependence.

articleTitle: TEM-cell Measurements of the Radiated Emissions from PCBs with Modal Reservation before and after Failure
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: In this paper, the levels of radiated emissions from printed circuit boards with modal reservation are estimated before and after failures. Four board prototypes (without modal reservation, and with modal reservation before and after short and open circuit failures) were manufactured to experimentally study their features. A laboratory model of a miniature TEM-cell was used to measure the frequency dependences up to 5 GHz of the voltage amplitude levels at its central conductor for all boards. The measured results obtained after failures were compared to those obtained before them. It was revealed that in general the level of radiated emissions for the board with modal reservation is lower than for the board without it even after failures, except at some frequencies of the studied domain, due to the frequency shifting. The study confirms experimentally the possibility of using the modal reservation layout and tracing approach for both improving the reliability and ensuring electromagnetic compatibility, in terms of not only the conductive emissions but also the radiated ones.

articleTitle: Microprocessor-Based Device for Monitoring the Insulation Resistance of DC Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The principle of operation of the developed micro-processor device for monitoring the insulation resistance of a DC system of the “UKI-MP01” type is described. This principle is to measure the values of the mains voltage and leakage current when the measuring circuit is alternately periodically connected to the poles of the network. The relationship between the input signals of the device and the value of the insulation resistance of the poles of the system relative to the “ground” is established, which underlies the proposed algorithm for the operation of the device. The device based on optokeys and a microcontroller operating according to the proposed algorithm makes it possible to automate the measurement process. As a result of testing and operating experience of the insulation control device of the “UKI-MP01” type in industrial conditions, the compliance of its main technical characteristics with the requirements of the industry standard was confirmed.

articleTitle: Investigation of Increasing the Stability of a Power System Using Supercapacitors
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Supercapacitors are electrochemical capacitors that differ significantly from conventional capacitors in their virtually unlimited durability, lower current losses, and higher power density values. At the same time, they have an order of magnitude smaller dimensions. This is a new generation battery that can open up numerous prospects in the energy sector.Great interest in supercapacitors is due to the possibility of replacing batteries, as well as the creation of flexible high-power power supplies. The strategic goal for scientists is to create high-capacity batteries that could be used in different areas, for example, for electric vehicles. This will allow you to travel long distances and quickly charge the batteries. It also guarantees a more economical operation of renewable energy sources by accumulating excess energy: wind turbines, solar panels, etc.The purpose of this article is study of the impact of using supercapacitors on the stability of frequency and rotor angle by doing several experiments with different capacities and voltages and then comparing the results which were obtained with the help of the program PSS/E.

articleTitle: An Improved Leakage Current Sensor for Insulation Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The principle of operation of leakage current sensors is based on the selection of the 2nd harmonic at the output of the dual winding. The influence of three-phase currents on the output signal of the sensor is eliminated by the wire of all three conductors through the common opening of the magnetic circuit of the sensor. The sum of the currents of the three phases with a common neutral is always zero in a symmetrical system, as well as in the presence of deviations in one of the load phases. However, as shown by the operation of an electric drive of the electric propulsion system for marine vessel, this rule may be violated where rotating field transformers are used to match voltage values and a phase shift of 30°. The resulting distortions and asymmetries can lead to saturation of the sensor’s magnetic circuit and the appearance of false readings from insulation monitoring system. To solve this problem, it was previously proposed to use a combination of several secondary windings, which compensated the mains frequency and the frequency of the 1st harmonic at the output, but could not affect the saturation effect of the magnetic circuit, which is facilitated by the use of a mu-metal type material with a high relative magnetic permeability. Even a slight violation of the symmetry of the currents can cause a malfunction of the leakage current sensor. This article proposes a new design of the leakage current sensor without the mentioned drawback.

articleTitle: Development of a Neural Network for Controlling the Polymerization of Isoprene in an Isopentane Solution Using a Virtual Analyzer
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: At the moment, the process of polymerization of isoprene in an isopentane solution makes it possible to obtain a semi-product for the production of synthetic rubber. It is used instead of natural both independently and in combination with other elastomers in the manufacture of almost all rubber products. To control the quality of the technological process, the development of a virtual analyzer is required. A neural network controller, a predicted virtual analyzer of the quality indicator of the flow rate and temperature of the catalytic complex, will increase the adaptability of the system. As a result of this work, a virtual analyzer was developed that continuously predicts the quality indicator of the process in the form of a mass fraction of the catalytic complex after the polymerizer and a neural network for regulating the technological parameters of isoprene polymerization in an isopentane solution.

articleTitle: Raiden. Power System Transient Stability Simulation Software Prototype
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: This paper discusses implementation details of the transient stability analysis prototype software “Raiden”, based on the implicit integration scheme. The main advantages of an implicit integration predictor-corrector scheme with combined treatment of differential and algebraic variables as well as an integration process with discrete events and discontinuities handling are considered. Special emphasis is placed on the ability to simulate custom equipment and protection models, as well as their automated implementation. The software implemented is a part of the stability monitoring system used by the System Operator for an online safe operation margins assessment. The results of test simulations and their comparison with existing software are presented for cases of different dimensions.

articleTitle: Energy Efficiency Indicators Calculation Algorithm for Oil and Gas Production Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Today oil and gas companies are forced to allocate significant resources to optimizing production, developing, and implementing measures to improve the energy efficiency of the exploration and production unit. It is necessary to ensure the required level of production and maintain the company’s profitability since the reserves of fossil raw materials tend to be exhausted. The calculation algorithm is presented in the paper to obtain the equipment energy efficiency indicators. The algorithm includes the module of power and electricity balance calculation in an enterprise distribution network. It evaluates the share of the technological processes’ consumption, analyzes losses, and determines the source of imbalance. Then the parameter identification method for rotating electrical machines is implemented to assess the individual indicators. As a result, the software prototype for energy efficiency indicators monitoring and control has been developed.

articleTitle: Development and Creation of an Experimental Bench for Checking the Results of Topological Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Today, permanent magnet synchronous motors (PMSM) are increasingly used in various industries due to their high efficiency and small size. However, the main drawback of these motors is the high cost, including due to the cost of permanent magnets (PM). It is possible to reduce the PM volume by changing the design of the rotor, by means of the optimal arrangement of materials (rotor topology). The desired topology of the rotor can be found using complex topological optimization based on a genetic algorithm. Evolutionary algorithms were chosen as a search method, and a genetic algorithm was chosen based on the comparison. All solutions in the field of changing the design of the PMSM are presented, and as a result, it is revealed that there are no works in the field of complex topological optimization. For the considered engine, a geometric model was built, verification was carried out, and as a result of changing the geometric model of the PMSM, the calculation time was reduced. A program has been developed and implemented for carrying out optimization in terms of torque with subsequent check cycles in terms of temperature and strength parameters. Thus, a new design of the PMSM with improved technical characteristics was obtained - the value of the moment increased by 9.5%, the volume of the PM decreased by 9.7%. To check the results of topological optimization, an experimental stand was developed and created.

articleTitle: Analysis and optimization of a Turn of a Meander Line with Broad-Side Coupling with Temperature Effect Consideration
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: The paper presents the results of analysis and optimization of a turn of a meander line with broad-side coupling performed by evolutionary methods. The study took into account the ambient temperature in the range from minus 50 to 150°C using a simple temperature model of the linear change of turn parameters. As a result of the analysis, it was revealed that a temperature change over the entire range leads to a decrease in the per-unit-length delays of the even and odd modes up to 2.35% and 3.24%, respectively. Meanwhile the maximum amplitude of the pulse signal at the turn output increases up to 1.31%, and the impedances of the even and odd modes increase up to 2.4% and 3.56%, respectively. The results demonstrated the possibility of parametric one- and two-criterion optimization of the turn cross-section using two methods: genetic algorithms and evolutionary strategies. The optimization results by two methods showed good agreement. However, with close sets of optimal parameters, the time for optimization by evolutionary strategies was 9 times less.

articleTitle: Development of Methods to optimize the Number and Places of Installation of Active-Adaptive Sectionalizing Elements with an Assessment of the Effectiveness of Measures in the Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Today there is no generally accepted methodology for determining the optimal locations of division of distribution network sections, despite a wide arsenal of sectionalizing equipment. Recently, active-adaptive elements with high technical efficiency have been widely used in 6(10) kV networks: automatic reclosers and load breakers. Their use contributes both to the self-restoration of distribution network sections under unstable faults and allows automatically localize stable faults. Widespread introduction of sectionalizing equipment should consider the economic feasibility (efficiency) of its installation, depending on many factors and the allowable payback period of measures. This work is aimed at solving the actual problem - the development of methods and algorithms for optimal selection of installation sites, type and number of sectioning devices for feeders (trunks and extended branches) for a particular loaded network. Decision-making criteria for feeders with different degrees of distributed load are the frequency and duration of power outages, the values of the average annual shortfalls of electricity and consumer losses, losses (load and no-load) when optimizing the points of network disconnection under the condition of maintaining normal voltage levels in the points of its release. Practical significance of the work consists in the development of methods and algorithms for optimal selection of installation locations, type and number of sectioning devices for ringed feeders with calculation of payback period of the invested funds.

articleTitle: Developing Highly Effective Strategy of Oil Production Submersible Electrical Equipment Repair and Operation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Ural Conference on Electrical Power Engineering (UralCon)
abstract: Optimizing and managing life cycles of submersible electrical equipment (SEE) in oil production requires a comprehensive approach to maintenance and repairs (MR) based on the development of a more advanced strategy of repair cycles. It is stated that MR strategies common in the oil production industry do not fully ensure the operation efficiency. Thus, there is an increase in premature equipment failures, a reduction in time between overhauls and, as a result, losses for oil companies. The advantages and disadvantages of approaches to SEE operation are evaluated using the running time and the actual equipment condition during planning, implementation of MR, as well as the feasibility of carrying out the two above side by side. It is proposed to use statistical models to make a reasoned decision on determining the scope and period of MR, forecasting the limit conditions of sets in general and for specific SEE electrical installations. For a given running time, it is possible to establish key patterns of emerging defects and the mean time between failures of single elements, as well as the whole fleet of equipment of an oil production enterprises. The results obtained can serve as a rationale for a set of recommendations to improve the efficiency of operation and to optimize the life cycle management of SEE in oil production.
